## Highlights

- A [custom provider](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/admin/providers#define-a-custom-provider) in front of an LLM gateway, such as Bifrost or LiteLLM, works like a shipped provider ([#5064](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/5064)):
  - A base URL that is not the API root says so. When the address answers with a web page (a gateway's dashboard address without `/v1`, say), the credential row, **Check models** and **Refresh catalogs** read "The base URL answered with a web page, not a model list. Check that it is the API root; for most gateways it ends in /v1."; when it has no model list, they say that and suggest entering the model IDs instead. Both read in English, German or French, instead of a JSON parser's message or a bare HTTP 404, and Tale asks the address once instead of three times.
  - Models a gateway lists without saying what they support carry what Tale knows about them. Behind a Bifrost gateway, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT 5.6 Luna and GPT 5.6 Sol now see the pictures attached in chat, take tools and offer an effort setting; before, all three read as taking none of these, so **Auto** passed them over whenever another provider's model took tools or the message carried a picture, and a picture sent to them reached them only as a mention. A model Tale does not know is offered with tools and without image input, and an embedding, speech or image model that Tale recognizes is no longer offered in chat.
  - A chat gets its title when the model naming it thinks first or would answer the message instead: the namer receives the first message as text to name, and a model that spends the title's budget thinking gets room and time for it. Claude behind a gateway named its chats in one call, where the chats used to keep the title made from their first words.
  - Names made from model IDs read a dashed version the way it is said, "Claude Sonnet 5.5" rather than "Claude Sonnet 5 5", in the model menu and in the `label` of `GET /api/v1/models`. The menu's search also matches a model's ID: `gpt-5.6` finds GPT 5.6 Luna.
- The Anthropic provider offers Claude Sonnet 5.5, with its 1M-token context window, image input, tools and effort setting, at USD 2 per million input and USD 10 per million output tokens ([#5064](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/5064)).
- [Video ingestion](https://docs.tale.dev/self-hosted/configuration/video-ingestion) fetches YouTube videos without captions again, and gets past proxies that a platform turns away ([#5066](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/5066)):
  - The image brings yt-dlp 2026.10.26. YouTube refused the audio downloads of the earlier version from every network, so every video without captions failed at its audio step.
  - Through [`OUTBOUND_PROXY_URLS`](https://docs.tale.dev/self-hosted/configuration/video-ingestion#egress-proxy), a video keeps one proxy for its metadata, captions and audio, starting on the proxy through which its platform last served a video. When the platform turns it away there with a bot check, a rate limit or a refused request, or the proxy fails, it moves to the next proxy that has not failed it, with up to five attempts for each yt-dlp call and no retry once the step has run 90 seconds. Before, every step took the next proxy in turn, and the first refusal failed the video. Through 100 shared data-center proxies, about two thirds of which YouTube turned away, 5 of 5 test videos came through with their metadata, captions and audio.
- [Image and music models that cannot use tools](https://docs.tale.dev/platform/chat/basics#choose-a-model-when-the-choice-matters) are no longer offered as chat models. Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, GPT-5 Image and the Lyria music models failed every message there, because every reply can call tools such as a document search. To get a picture, ask for one in the conversation: when an admin has turned on image generation, the assistant creates it with the organization's image model ([#5062](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/5062)).

## Upgrade notes

- No migration runs, and the API contract stays at `3.49.0`.
- In an organization with a custom provider whose model listing does not say what its models support (an LLM gateway, or a server's bare `/v1/models`), the models Tale's catalogs know now take the catalog's facts on image input, tools and an effort setting, and the others count as taking tools, as rows without a context window or price already did. **Auto** can now choose them where it passed them over, pictures attached in chat are sent to them as images, which the vendor bills as image input, the model endpoints for API keys no longer refuse their tools or images, and `GET /api/v1/models` reports the new capabilities. An embedding, speech or image model that such a listing names, and that Tale's catalogs know as one, leaves the chat model lists.
- **Auto** no longer chooses a model that charges nothing for its output. An embedding model that Tale's catalogs do not know, listed by a gateway without a description, now reads as a chat model with tools and would otherwise win Auto's price fallback.
- A chat title from a model known to think may now use up to 2,048 output tokens and 30 seconds. A model that spends the title's 48 tokens thinking is asked once more with up to 2,048, within 30 seconds of the first call's start. Every call is booked like any other title.
- For video ingestion through `OUTBOUND_PROXY_URLS`, list a proxy provider's fixed-address endpoints, often numbered user names on one gateway, instead of one rotating endpoint. YouTube can refuse a download from another address than the one that asked for it, and a rotating endpoint gives every connection a new address. `VIDEO_INGEST_PROXY_URL` can instead give video a proxy of its own, which, as a single proxy, does not repeat a refused attempt. The worker logs each move by the proxy's position in the list, never its credentials. Recreate the backend and `sandbox-egress` after changing the list. A yt-dlp of your own (`VIDEO_INGEST_BIN_DIR`) older than 2026.10.26 makes the worker warn; upgrade it.
- A chat or an agent on an image or music model that takes no tools is now refused, and a saved chat model pick on one falls back to **Auto**. `GET /api/v1/models` and the model endpoints for API keys no longer list such models. OpenRouter text models without tool support, such as Phi 4, Perplexity Sonar and small Gemma models, are still listed and fail the same way ([#5063](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/issues/5063)).
